steps.en: Build the CLI once against Highway, lcms2, libjpeg and libpng
steps.zh: 装好 Highway、lcms2 等依赖，编译一次命令行工具

steps.en: Encode the same source image with each codec setting you want to compare
steps.zh: 用每组待比较的编码参数压同一张原图

steps.en: Run it with the original first and the compressed image second
steps.zh: 运行时原图在前、压缩图在后

steps.en: Converts both to the XYB colour space and builds SSIM, ringing and blur error maps at 6 scales
steps.zh: 转到 XYB 色彩空间，在 6 个尺度上算 SSIM、振铃、模糊误差图

steps.en: Pools 108 error norms with tuned weights into one score, 100 meaning lossless
steps.zh: 按调好的权重把 108 个误差范数合成一个分数，100 为无损

value.en: One number per encode whose anchors (90 visually lossless, 70 high, 50 medium) track human ratings, so codec settings can be ranked without a viewing panel
value.zh: 每次编码一个分数，刻度（90 视觉无损、70 高、50 中）对得上人眼评分，不用观测实验也能给参数排序

sources: https://github.com/cloudinary/ssimulacra2 README — Building (apt install libhwy-dev liblcms2-dev libjpeg62-turbo-dev libpng-dev cmake ninja-build; cmake ../src -G Ninja; ninja ssimulacra2)
https://github.com/cloudinary/ssimulacra2 README — Usage (ssimulacra2 original.png distorted.png; score range and anchors)
https://github.com/cloudinary/ssimulacra2 README — How it works (XYB, three error maps, 6 scales, 1-norm and 4-norm, 108 weighted norms)
